sources.text: You may feel frustrated and stranded in family matters today, says Ganesha. Shower your warmth and care to make up for past mistakes. Your spouse will be supportive and lend you a helping hand to regain your mental composure.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Today's planetary configurations indicate that you can expect a very profitable period coming up, Taurus. You've worked hard lately, and it's only natural that you should finally arrive at this stage. You're going to be able to measure the distance you've come, and above all, evaluate your power. Whatever you do, think big!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You'll feel inspired to perfect your craft as the Moon debuts in Virgo, dearest Taurus, blessing you with an influx of stamina and creativity. Your body craves movement, but the mind seeks stimulation, so be sure to take a hands-on approach to learning. Pace yourself to avoid simple mistakes while Uranus activates, or you could unleash unintended chaos. Luckily, transgressions such as these will be easily forgiven as your natural Charisma shines more brightly than usual.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Evenings at the movie- theatre or dinner with your spouse seem to keep you in a relaxed and wonderful mood Those who were going through financial crisis for a long time can attain money from anywhere today, which will eliminate several life problems in an instant. Time spent with family- children and friends will be vital to regenerate your energy. Those who were very busy for the last few days will finally get to enjoy their own time. Your spouse will come to you with some beautiful words today describing your value in his/her life.

readings.text: Today is your day. Some external forces will likely to bore you. As a result, you will feel lazy and inactive and will avoid doing anything more than your routine work. However, you will be able to achieve the tasks effectively and maintain the consistency, foresees Ganesha.

Take care of personal issues now so that you can have a fresh start as the week begins. This is the day to focus on yourself and your own needs. Be selfish. Put yourself first. This will give you a more solid foundation to work from next week.

readings.text: You need to save as much money as possible today, advises Ganesha. must should shun silly concerns and enjoy quality time with your near and dear ones. Be simple and straightforward, and not too calculative.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

readings.text: Ganesha foresees that you may face some issues in the professional and personal realm today. However, do not get upset, if the situation is difficult to handle or control. Take help of your elders and seniors to overcome the adversities.

An excellent day for you! If you are a lawyer, or someone who communicates two sides of an issue for a living, you are apt to have a successful day. There are two sides to every story, and in the case of the body it is important to rest as well as to exercise. The astral energy lends itself to increasing the balance in your physical health. If you're overtired, take a nap!
